questiondescription.text:
Linear Inequalities: writing inequalities from rules

Grade 12 CBE Essential 1.3: Choose the inequality sign that matches the words of a rule or limit.

Essential

This question is adapted from Chapter 28 (Solving inequalities), Section A, question A8 of Ling, J., Scruton, P., Shilton, S. and West, H., SMP GCSE Mathematics: Higher 1 for AQA, Edexcel and OCR two-tier GCSE mathematics, Cambridge University Press, 2006: new Kenyan rules and limits, with the sign chosen from a list.
